hook: Forces on one MOF particle stuck to an AFM tip predict how its polymer composite performs.
hook_turn: predict how its polymer composite performs.
summary: Pressing a single MOF particle on an AFM probe into polymer films yielded a two-variable descriptor of chemical compatibility and adhesion. It tracked polymer intercalation seen by X-ray scattering, and a linear model predicted CO2 uptake in UiO-66-NH2 composites. The prediction was shown only with the MOF held fixed.
title: An Experimental MOF-Polymer Latent Space for Composite Design
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
